title: Mock 5 · Full Sweep
blurb: Last easy lap: fills the remaining gaps before the tough mocks.

questions.q: Which is cited as a key growth driver for InvITs in India?
options: The government's push for infrastructure growth
questions.explanation: Key growth drivers for InvITs: the government's push for infrastructure growth and a high GDP growth rate.
hints: Correct: government infrastructure push.
Gold imports are irrelevant.
Residential rentals are not cited, and REITs focus on commercial property.
It is HIGH GDP growth that is cited.

questions.q: Which challenge is common to both REITs and InvITs in India, according to the deck?
options: Low awareness among investors and a limited number of quality assets
questions.explanation: Both REITs and InvITs face low awareness among investors and a limited number of quality assets.
hints: No such lock-in is mentioned.
Units are listed; listing is not prohibited.
Correct: low awareness and few quality assets.
Both are regulated by SEBI.

questions.q: Which are cited as key growth drivers for REITs?
options: Government push for highways and telecom towers
Urbanisation and demand for office spaces
questions.explanation: Key growth drivers for REITs: urbanisation and demand for office spaces.
hints: Highways and telecom are InvIT themes.
Correct: urbanisation and office demand.
Falling interest would hurt, not drive, REITs.
Agriculture is irrelevant.

questions.q: After the Budget 2024 changes, what does the deck say about tax-loss harvesting?
options: It is compulsory before every sale
It is now available only to non-residents
It is still possible, though opportunities are reduced
questions.explanation: Tax planning: tax-loss harvesting is still possible, though opportunities are reduced due to higher LTCG tax on debt MFs and removal of indexation.
hints: It is a planning option, not compulsory.
It was not banned.
No NRI-only rule is mentioned.
Correct: still possible, fewer opportunities.

questions.q: Which are given in the deck as examples of tax-deferment vehicles an IA may use?
questions.explanation: Implications for IAs list tax deferment vehicles, e.g. mutual funds or NPS.
hints: Savings interest is taxed yearly; not cited as a deferment vehicle.
Credit cards are not investments.
Monthly-payout FDs are taxed as interest accrues; not cited.
Correct: MFs or NPS.

questions.q: Under the ODR requirements, what change must IAs make to their investment advisory agreements?
options: Add a provision that the parties agree to online conciliation and/or online arbitration through the ODR Portal
Add a clause making BSE a party to the agreement
Add a clause waiving SCORES rights
questions.explanation: IAs must amend agreements so the parties agree to undertake online conciliation and/or online arbitration by participating in the ODR Portal.
hints: Correct: add the ODR conciliation/arbitration clause.
Grievance clauses must be updated, not removed.
BSE is not a party to advisory agreements.
Investors cannot be made to waive SCORES.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed as content of the half-yearly periodic report to BSE?
options: Details of bank accounts used for fee receipt
Details of complaints and ageing analysis
questions.explanation: The report covers registration details, shareholding, NISM/PAIA details, social media handles, fee bank accounts, PO/CO/MD details, advertisements, complaints with ageing, clients/AUM/fee mode, etc. Clients' ITRs are not listed.
hints: Social media handles are listed.
Correct: client ITRs are not part of the report.
Bank accounts for fees are listed.
Complaints and ageing are listed.

questions.q: Where must an IA display a link to the ODR Portal?
options: On the home page of its website and mobile apps
questions.explanation: ODR requirements: display a link to the ODR Portal on the home page of websites and mobile apps.
hints: The annual report alone is not enough.
IAs must display it.
Correct: website and app home page.
Invoices are not the prescribed place.

questions.q: What happened to existing SEBI-registered IAs holding BASL/BSE membership on July 25, 2024?
options: They had to re-apply for registration with SEBI
They were enlisted on the Exchange (BSE) automatically
questions.explanation: All existing SEBI registered RAs and IAs holding BASL/BSE membership were enlisted on the Exchange w.e.f. July 25, 2024.
hints: No fresh SEBI application was needed.
NSE is not involved.
Correct: enlisted on BSE w.e.f. July 25, 2024.
Registrations did not lapse.

questions.q: What must accompany statistical information, graphs or charts in an IA advertisement?
options: The logo of the stock exchange
Their source, e.g. certification by a practising professional or another authentic verifiable source
A guarantee that the trend will continue
questions.explanation: Mandatory inclusions: statistical information/graphs/charts should be supported by their source, i.e. certification by a practising professional or another authentic verifiable source.
hints: Exchange logos are prohibited without approval.
Correct: the source must be given.
Guarantees are prohibited.
Client signatures are irrelevant.

questions.q: If an IA is also a distributor of some products, what must its advertisement mention?
options: Specifically, in the disclaimer, that it is only a distributor of such products
The commission rate on each product
questions.explanation: Mandatory inclusions: for distributor/s of any product, mention specifically in the disclaimer that they are only distributor/s of such products.
hints: Correct: the 'only distributor' disclaimer.
Commission rates are not the prescribed disclosure.
Disclosure is mandatory.
Guarantees are prohibited.

questions.q: For a video ad, which example is given of a clear and understandable voice-over of the standard warning?
options: Any speed, if the text is on screen
20 words running for at least 10 seconds
questions.explanation: Voice-over reiteration must be audible and clear; e.g. both visual and voice-over containing 20 words running for at least 10 seconds.
hints: Not the example given.
That is far too fast.
Voice-over must itself be clear.
Correct: 20 words over at least 10 seconds.

questions.q: Which of these is a mandatory disclosure in every IA advertisement?
options: SEBI registration number and BSE enlistment number
Names of the IA's top five clients
questions.explanation: Mandatory disclosures include the IA's name and CIN, type and validity of registration, SEBI registration and BSE enlistment number, registered office address with phone numbers, and logo/brand name.
hints: Turnover is not required.
Correct: SEBI registration and BSE enlistment numbers.
A personal mobile is not required; the registered office phone is.
Client names must never be disclosed.

questions.q: Within what time of completing VAPT must the report and MD/CEO declaration be submitted to SEBI?
questions.explanation: VAPT report submission with MD/CEO declaration: within 1 month of completion of VAPT.
hints: 15 days is the CCI evidence timeline for Qualified REs.
3 months is the closure-of-findings timeline.
6 months is not a VAPT timeline.
Correct: within 1 month.

questions.q: Findings identified during VAPT must be closed within what time?
options: Within 3 months of submission of the VAPT report
Before the next financial year ends
questions.explanation: Closure of findings identified during VAPT: within 3 months of submission of the VAPT report.
hints: Correct: 3 months from report submission.
1 week is not the timeline.
The timeline is 3 months, not FY end.
1 month is the report submission timeline.

questions.q: What must a Self-certification RE submit instead of a cyber audit report?
options: A compliance report as per Annexure-P signed by MD/CEO/Board Member/Partners/Proprietor
questions.explanation: Cyber audit is not applicable for Self-certification REs; they submit a compliance report as per Annexure-P signed by MD/CEO/Board Member/Partners/Proprietor.
hints: ISO 27001 is required of Qualified REs.
They must submit a compliance report.
Correct: Annexure-P self-certified compliance report.
CERT-In empanelment applies to auditors.

questions.q: In the cybersecurity layers diagram, firewalls, VPNs and DDoS protection belong to which layer?
questions.explanation: The layers diagram lists firewall, VPN, security gateway and DDoS protection under Network Security.
hints: Application security covers threat modelling, secure coding.
Data security covers encryption, DLP, email security.
Correct: network security.
Physical security covers access control, lighting, biometrics.

questions.q: According to the Investor Charter, what should an investor do first in case of a grievance against an IA?
questions.explanation: Grievance mechanism: first approach the concerned IA; if not redressed satisfactorily, lodge a complaint on SEBI SCORES.
hints: Social media is not a redressal channel.
Police are not the first step for advisory grievances.
Court is not the first step.
Correct: approach the IA first.

questions.q: In the monthly complaints data that IAs must disclose, complaints are grouped by source. Which is one of the listed sources?
questions.explanation: The format lists: directly from investors, SEBI (SCORES), and other sources (if any).
hints: The tax department is not listed.
Correct: SEBI (SCORES) is a listed source.
Credit bureaus are not listed.
NISM is not a listed source.

questions.q: Under the IA code of conduct, when conflicts of interest cannot be avoided, the IA must:
options: Make appropriate disclosures to clients and ensure they are treated fairly
questions.explanation: Conflicts of interest: avoid as far as possible; when unavoidable, ensure appropriate disclosures and fair treatment of clients.
hints: Correct: disclose and treat clients fairly.
A fee cut does not address the conflict.
Disclosure must be to clients.
Stopping all advice is not required.

questions.q: Under the Intermediaries Regulations code, what does 'Disbursal of amounts' require?
options: Refund of all fees on demand
Disbursal of advisory fees to employees within 7 days
Prompt disbursal of dividends, interest or other accruals received on behalf of clients
questions.explanation: Disbursal of amounts: an intermediary shall be prompt in disbursing dividends, interests or any accrual income received or collected on behalf of clients.
hints: Profits are not paid to SEBI.
Fee refunds on demand are not this clause.
Employee pay is not covered.
Correct: prompt disbursal of client accruals.

questions.q: An investor overpays heavily just to win a competitive bid for an asset. This is called:
questions.explanation: Winner's curse: the tendency to make sure a competitive bid is won even after overpaying; a behavioural win but possibly a financial loss.
hints: Correct: winner's curse.
Gambler's fallacy is about predicting random events.
Confirmation bias is seeking confirming information.
Myopic loss aversion is about loss sensitivity.

questions.q: After five consecutive falls in a stock, an investor buys because 'it is now due to go up'. Which bias is this?
questions.explanation: Gambler's fallacy is predicting random events on the basis of what happened in the past, or seeing trends where none exist.
hints: Anchoring fixes on initial information.
Correct: gambler's fallacy.
Ambiguity aversion avoids unknown odds.
Ownership bias overvalues what one owns.

questions.q: Which criteria are listed for evaluating asset allocation strategies?
options: Risks involved, costs of transactions and taxes, and behaviour management
questions.explanation: Evaluating strategies: risks involved, costs of transactions and taxes, and behaviour management.
hints: Brand is irrelevant.
Fund count is not a listed criterion.
Correct: risk, costs/taxes and behaviour.
Past returns alone are not the criteria.

questions.q: According to the key takeaways, what is the test of an asset allocation?
options: It should be changed every quarter
The investor should be able to stay with it for the desired time horizon
It should beat inflation every month
questions.explanation: Key takeaway: the test of the asset allocation is that the investor should be able to stay with it for the desired time horizon.
hints: Frequent changes are not the test.
Correct: the investor can stay with it.
Zero volatility is impossible for growth assets.
Monthly inflation-beating is unrealistic and not the test.
